title: crataegus horrida var. chrysocarpa
intro: Crataegus horrida var. chrysocarpa, commonly known as the yellow-fruited horrid hawthorn, is a plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. The yellow-fruited horrid hawthorn has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat cardiovascular issues, and its health benefits include lowering blood pressure, improving heart function, and enhancing circulation. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to act as a vasodilator, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, which helps in reducing the risk of heart disease and other cardiovascular conditions. The bioactive constituents of C. horrida var. chrysocarpa include flavonoids, oligomeric proanthocyanidins (OPCs), and other phenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
